aggregation_conventions.input: six saved matched-host summaries only; no model inference or waveform access
aggregation_conventions.means: recording-equal-weight arithmetic mean; missing values never imputed
aggregation_conventions.common_success: intersection of measured case IDs for all three methods within metric and semitone
aggregation_conventions.all_120: separate boundary_hold versus pml success intersection with 120 cases
aggregation_conventions.contrast: boundary_hold minus comparator, paired by case within metric and semitone

bootstrap.ordering: case and speaker IDs sorted lexicographically
bootstrap.estimator: sum of selected cluster difference sums / sum of selected recording counts; all recordings included with cluster multiplicity
